Video Editor Best — Version 1.0.0

- First release: Instantly edit and export polished videos by describing your desired changes.
- Upload MP4, MOV, AVI, or WebM videos up to 500MB; AI handles cutting pauses, adding transitions, and exporting final cuts.
- Automatic cloud-based editing—no need to learn complex software.
- Seamless session/authentication workflow with free starter credits for new users.
- Quick processing: most edits complete within 1–2 minutes.
- Supports easy file upload, timeline previews, and batch or iterative editing workflows.
